Evan: Quick sync note from customer call — they want a single chat turn to orchestrate multiple tool calls (mix of parallel and ordered), per-call timeouts, and a shared retry budget. They also want results streamed as they arrive.
Priya: Important for roadmap. We should avoid implicit behavior. Expose a clear plan object: `mode` (parallel|ordered|hybrid), `calls[]` each with `timeout_ms`, `retries_allowed`, `idempotency_key?`, and an optional `ordering_hint`.
Noah: MVP proposal: support `parallel` with streaming and `ordered` (strict sequence). Hybrid (grouped ordering inside parallel groups) for later. Default `max_concurrency` = 3, account cap 6. No distributed transactions in MVP.
Rina: Observability must include per-call span id, attempts, latency_ms, bytes, and `trace_id` tying the whole turn. This is required for billing and debugging.
Evan: API example (compact): `{ "mode":"parallel", "max_concurrency":3, "calls":[{"tool":"price","timeout_ms":400},{"tool":"charge","timeout_ms":1200,"idempotency_key":"tok-1"}] , "emit_partial": true, "global_retry_budget":2 }`
Priya: Retry rules: require explicit idempotency key for non-idempotent calls to allow retries. Runtime should warn in response metadata if retry budget used for non-idempotent call without key.
Noah: Streaming semantics: in parallel mode stream each call result as it completes. In ordered mode buffer and emit in order. Document that `ordering_hint` is best-effort unless mode==ordered.
Rina: Security: for Private deployments require outbound allowlist and scrub logs unless customer opts in. Surface a warning when retries enabled for non-idempotent calls.
Evan: Launch checklist: RFC + JSON schema, SDK snippets (JS/Python streaming), perf tests with 1/3/6 concurrency cost model, telemetry + billing attribution, and one enterprise canary.
Priya: Non-goals: sagas, automatic compensation, long-running workflows. Track those as future epics.
Noah: Action items: Priya + Noah draft RFC and sample SDK code; Rina defines telemetry acceptance tests; Evan will coordinate the canary and customer FAQ. Target: RFC in 2 weeks, internal alpha in 6 weeks.
security-bot: Created SEC-501: "outbound-invokes-review" assigned to security team.
Evan: Thanks — we'll iterate on RFC and bring to product sync next week.
